question_text: Classify the objects or materials given below as opaque, transparent or translucent and luminous or non-luminous.

subject: science
question_text: Can you think of creating a shape that would give a circular shadow if held in one way and a rectangular shadow if held in another way?
answer_text: A cylindrical shape can give a circular shadow when light is incident from its top or bottom. It will give a rectangular shadow when light is incident from its side.
final_answer: Thus, a cylindrical shape can create both types of shadows.
difficulty_reasoning: Requires understanding of light and shadow formation.

subject: science
question_text: In a completely dark room, if you hold up a mirror in front of you, will you see a reflection of yourself in the mirror?
answer_text: No, we will not be able to see our reflection in the mirror because there is no source of light in the room.
final_answer: Therefore, without light, no reflection is visible.
difficulty_reasoning: Direct recall of the effect of light on reflection.
